en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfront promenade with stone paving and a low sea wall, in front of a row of low buildings and a prominent two‑storey neoclassical corner building. Handwritten text in ink covers the upper part of the image. Along the right side, printed vertical captions in French and Greek identify the view. A web watermark with a modern URL appears near the bottom.
